title: AI reconnaissance and enhanced malware coding; defenses (shared secrets, MFA, verify output)
goal_html: Students triage the Meridian Bank server log in the simulation, identify which entries indicate AI-assisted reconnaissance, map each flagged entry to the recon technique it represents, and name the specific defense control that would limit that technique. Each pair produces a completed analysis table and one original log entry of their own as an exit ticket.
steps_html:
1. Triage the sim (8 min). One partner drives the simulation; the other narrates. Work through all 8 log entries. Check boxes for entries you believe are recon indicators. Do not submit yet, discuss each selection before clicking Submit.

  2. Submit and record results (3 min). Click Submit. Note your score. For each entry the sim marks as incorrect, read the explanation and update your understanding.

  3. Complete the analysis table (10 min). For each of the 3 confirmed recon entries, fill in the table below. Use the defense names from problem/prompt.md (exact strings matter for the coding problem).

Line Log text (abbreviated) Recon technique Defense control
2 Port scan 1-65535 in 4s
4 DNS burst 847 subdomain queries in 2s
6 Login attempts: 312 usernames in 8s
  1. Exit ticket, write your own log entry (4 min). Each partner independently writes one new log line that would signal AI-assisted reconnaissance (different from the three already seen). Write the defense that would address it. Examples are permitted to use subdomain enumeration, user-agent cycling, CVE scanning, or any other technique from the atom.
collaborate_html: Assign roles before Step 1: one person is the Security Analyst (decides which entries to flag and explains why), the other is the Defense Architect (names the control for each flagged entry). Swap roles for the exit ticket. If you disagree on a classification, write both positions and the reasoning, the sim's explanation will arbitrate.
exit_html: Each student submits individually: - One original log entry simulating AI-assisted reconnaissance (written by that student, not copied from the sim). - The name of the defense control that would limit the technique shown in their entry. - One sentence explaining why the entry indicates automated rather than human activity.
